title: Build the lawful point-in-time evidence archive
goal: Implement a lawful append-only data foundation for public SEC filings plus timestamped market, FX, calendar and corporate-action observations. Every simulated decision must be reproducible from content-addressed raw inputs. HTTP 403, missing licenses, missing timestamps or ambiguous corrections fail closed; no bypass, paid purchase or trading edge is added.

approval.note: User authorised autonomous repository implementation on 2026-08-06. Real orders, broker/wallet access, paid data purchases and capital deployment remain excluded.

acceptance.assertion: A versioned source matrix records provider, permitted use, attribution, retention, redistribution, rate limits, cost and point-in-time properties; unknown or paid terms block ingestion until separately approved.

SEC submissions and ownership XML use only the exact-host read-only client and are archived append-only with retrieval time, final URL, status, content hash and parser revision; HTTP 403 is preserved and never bypassed.
Market quote and FX adapters require timezone-aware observation times, currency identity, provenance and bid/ask or conservative substitutes; future observations cannot enter earlier decisions.
Splits, symbol changes, delistings, distributions, sessions and holidays are represented or fail closed before validation claims.
A manifest binds raw inputs, normalized records, configuration, code commit and output digest for offline reproduction.
Safety tests prove no broker, wallet, order, leverage, CFD, option, short or automatic capital path exists.
Focused and full Alpha Lab tests, compile checks, examples and git diff checks pass on the exact reviewed head.

metadata.known_blocker: A direct SEC archive request from the Heim-PC returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-06; diagnose compliant access or preserve the blocker, never evade it.

acceptance_evidence.source-legality-matrix: Versioned fail-closed source matrix shipped in docs/source-legality-v1.json.
acceptance_evidence.append-only-sec-archive: Content-addressed append-only SEC archive and retrieval records shipped; HTTP errors remain archived and are not bypassed.
acceptance_evidence.market-fx-contract: Timestamp, timezone, currency, provenance and conservative substitution contracts are implemented and tested.
acceptance_evidence.corporate-actions-and-calendars: Sessions, holidays, splits, symbol changes, delistings and distributions are implemented and tested.
acceptance_evidence.reproducible-manifest: Content-addressed reproducibility manifests bind raw inputs, normalized records, configuration and code identity.
acceptance_evidence.no-live-execution-regression: Static safety tests reject broker, wallet, order, leverage, CFD, option, short and capital surfaces.
acceptance_evidence.validation-green: Exact reviewed head passed local validation and both required GitHub Python jobs before merge.

does_not_establish: permission for real trading or capital deployment
availability or licensing of future market-data providers
future correctness after later repository changes
